title: COP31 in Antalya Runs Late: Fossil Fuel Fight, 'Worst COP Ever' and What It Means for India
description_html:
Why did COP31 in Antalya, Turkiye, run past its deadline? Nearly 200 countries are deadlocked after a slimmer draft removed every mention of fossil fuels and dropped a 120 billion dollar adaptation target. We cover Saudi Arabia and other producers' objections, the EU's 'fossil summit' warning, Panama's walk-out threat, the absent United States, and what a weak deal means for the US, Europe, the Gulf, East Asia and India.

Sources: Reports from COP31 negotiations, statements from the COP31 presidency, the European Union, Ghana, Panama and campaigners including Power Shift Africa, and the UN's latest emissions report. Claims labelled as reported or alleged are not verified by us.
